from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
base=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u024/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    counts = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row)
    foreground = min(counts, key=counts.get)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c in range(1, len(row) - 1):
            if row[c - 1] == foreground and row[c + 1] == foreground and row[c] != foreground:
                out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
path=base/'task-d08396ac.py'
path.write_text(program)
print(path, path.read_text())
